fields.description: Fay Al Reeman II is Aldar’s second Fay villa collection in Al Shamkha, Abu Dhabi. Three to six bedroom homes are supported by parks, play areas, sports courts and community facilities. The original offering included different exterior styles, interior finishes and upgrade choices.

research.community: Fay Al Reeman II · Al Shamkha
overview: The brochure presents standard and premium finish palettes alongside alternative villa drawings. Confirm the specification selected for the home, and whether any customization opportunity remains available at its current construction stage. An original upgrade option should not be treated as included in a resale.
research.locationNote: Fay Al Reeman II is within Alreeman 2, Al Shamkha. Check the actual villa plot and community access; listings for the wider Alreeman land community are not interchangeable with a completed villa specification.
research.priceNote: The phase-II factsheet gives AED 2.9m. Property Finder now displays a starting reference of AED 3.5m and marks developer stock sold out. The historical launch figure is not a current available-home quotation.
research.paymentNote: The original factsheet specifies 30/70. Property Finder divides this into 10% booking, 20% during construction and 70% handover. These are reference terms; a resale statement or later offer can have different balances.
research.handoverNote: Aldar’s FY2025 pipeline lists completion in 2027. Property Finder gives February 2027. Confirm the villa-specific date with Aldar; older marketing estimates should not be relied on as the current programme.

facts.label: Phase-specific details
facts.value: The phase-II factsheet records 557 villas and a 304–495 sqm range. Portal sample ranges differ slightly at the smaller end, so the selected home’s signed area schedule should settle the measurement.

facts.label: Buying eligibility
facts.value: The phase-II factsheet describes a community welcoming all nationalities. The website also contains legacy wording about Emirati-only homes; confirm eligibility and the individual title instead of relying on that mixed page copy.
